# #273 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m273_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m273_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m273_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m273_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 273 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_assign_candidate_owner_273
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m273_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m273_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m273_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m273_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m273_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m273_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m273_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_candidate_ownership
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_resource_candidate
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_resource_credit
						}
					var:zg361_we_m273_object_type_code = 273
					var:zg361_we_m273_consumer_contract = 273
					var:zg361_we_m273_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m273_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m273_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m273_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m273_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m273_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m273_object_case = var:zg361_we_m273_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m273_object_state = var:zg361_we_m273_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m273_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_type_code = 273
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_consumer_contract = 273
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m273_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m273_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m273_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m273_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m273_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m273_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m273_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m273_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m273_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m273_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m273_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m273_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m273_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m273_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m273_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m273_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m273_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m273_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m273_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m273_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m273_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m273_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m273_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_assign_candidate_owner_273 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m273_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m273_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_consumer_assign_candidate_owner_273 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m273_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #273 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.
zg361_we_m273_route_a_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_we_runtime_applied
	remove_variable = zg361_we_last_red_code

	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {

				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ad_state

				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 1
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m273_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m273_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m273_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m273_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m273_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m273_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 1
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}

# #271 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m271_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m271_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m271_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m271_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 271 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_register_referral_271
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m271_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m271_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m271_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m271_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m271_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m271_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m271_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_referral
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_resource_gold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_resource_referral
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_resource_interview
						}
					var:zg361_we_m271_object_type_code = 271
					var:zg361_we_m271_consumer_contract = 271
					var:zg361_we_m271_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m271_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m271_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m271_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m271_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m271_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m271_object_case = var:zg361_we_m271_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m271_object_state = var:zg361_we_m271_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m271_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_type_code = 271
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_consumer_contract = 271
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m271_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m271_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m271_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m271_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m271_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m271_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m271_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m271_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m271_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m271_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m271_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m271_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m271_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m271_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m271_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m271_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m271_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m271_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m271_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m271_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m271_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m271_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m271_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_register_referral_271 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m271_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m271_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_consumer_register_referral_271 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m271_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #267 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m267_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m267_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m267_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m267_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 267 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_seal_interview_votes_267
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m267_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m267_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m267_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m267_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m267_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m267_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m267_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_interview_ballot
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_resource_interview
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_resource_evidence
						}
					var:zg361_we_m267_object_type_code = 267
					var:zg361_we_m267_consumer_contract = 267
					var:zg361_we_m267_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m267_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m267_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m267_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m267_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m267_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m267_object_case = var:zg361_we_m267_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m267_object_state = var:zg361_we_m267_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m267_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m267_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_type_code = 267
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_consumer_contract = 267
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m267_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m267_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m267_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m267_write_cycle

# #268 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m268_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m268_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m268_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m268_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 268 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_calibrate_interviewers_268
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m268_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m268_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m268_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m268_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m268_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m268_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m268_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_interviewer_calibration
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_resource_interview
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_resource_calibration
						}
					var:zg361_we_m268_object_type_code = 268
					var:zg361_we_m268_consumer_contract = 268
					var:zg361_we_m268_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m268_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m268_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m268_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m268_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m268_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m268_object_case = var:zg361_we_m268_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m268_object_state = var:zg361_we_m268_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m268_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_type_code = 268
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_consumer_contract = 268
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m268_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m268_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m268_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m268_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m268_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m268_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m268_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m268_consumed_case

					var:zg361_we_m268_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m268_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m268_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m268_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m268_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m268_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m268_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m268_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m268_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m268_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m268_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m268_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m268_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_calibrate_interviewers_268 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m268_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m268_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_consumer_calibrate_interviewers_268 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m268_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #270 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m270_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m270_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m270_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m270_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 270 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_set_hiring_risk_policy_270
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m270_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m270_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m270_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m270_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m270_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m270_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m270_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_hiring_risk_policy
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_resource_hiring_policy
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_resource_interview
						}
					var:zg361_we_m270_object_type_code = 270
					var:zg361_we_m270_consumer_contract = 270
					var:zg361_we_m270_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m270_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m270_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m270_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m270_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m270_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m270_object_case = var:zg361_we_m270_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m270_object_state = var:zg361_we_m270_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m270_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_type_code = 270
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_consumer_contract = 270
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m270_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m270_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m270_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m270_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m270_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m270_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m270_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m270_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m270_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m270_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m270_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m270_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m270_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m270_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m270_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m270_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m270_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m270_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m270_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m270_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m270_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m270_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m270_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_set_hiring_risk_policy_270 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m270_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m270_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_consumer_set_hiring_risk_policy_270 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m270_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #270 route A: guard -> atomic precheck -> receipt -> write -> consumer.

# #272 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m272_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m272_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m272_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m272_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 272 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m272_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m272_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_we_m272_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m272_write_state

				has_variable = zg361_we_m272_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m272_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m272_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m272_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m272_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m272_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m272_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m272_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_offer

						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_case

						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_id

						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_resource_promotion
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_object_due_cycle

					var:zg361_we_m272_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m272_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m272_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m272_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m272_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m272_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m272_object_case = var:zg361_we_m272_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m272_object_state = var:zg361_we_m272_write_state

					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m272_debt_state

# #274 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m274_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m274_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m274_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m274_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 274 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_resolve_counteroffer_274
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m274_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m274_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m274_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m274_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m274_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m274_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_counteroffer
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_resource_gold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_resource_offer
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_resource_formal_hc
						}
					var:zg361_we_m274_object_type_code = 274
					var:zg361_we_m274_consumer_contract = 274
					var:zg361_we_m274_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m274_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m274_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m274_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m274_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m274_object_case = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m274_object_state = var:zg361_we_m274_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m274_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_type_code = 274
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_consumer_contract = 274
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m274_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m274_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m274_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m274_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m274_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m274_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m274_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m274_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m274_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m274_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m274_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m274_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m274_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m274_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_resolve_counteroffer_274 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m274_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m274_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_consumer_resolve_counteroffer_274 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m274_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #275 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m275_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m275_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m275_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m275_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 275 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m275_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m275_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_we_m275_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m275_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m275_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m275_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_hc_hold
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_object_owner

					var:zg361_we_m275_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m275_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m275_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m275_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m275_object_case = var:zg361_we_m275_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m275_object_state = var:zg361_we_m275_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_debt_subject

					var:zg361_we_m275_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m275_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m275_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m275_debt_type_code = 275
					var:zg361_we_m275_debt_consumer_contract = 275

					var:zg361_we_m275_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m275_expected_debt_id

					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m275_consumed_subject

					var:zg361_we_m275_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m275_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m275_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m275_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m275_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m275_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m275_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_handle_offer_refusal_275 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m275_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m275_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_consumer_handle_offer_refusal_275 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m275_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #269 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.

	if = {

					var:zg361_we_m269_object_case = var:zg361_we_m269_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m269_object_state = var:zg361_we_m269_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {

					var:zg361_we_m269_debt_open = 1

		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m269_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m269_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m269_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m269_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m269_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_write_back_hire_quality_269 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m269_write_case }

		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m269_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #276 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m276_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m276_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m276_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m276_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m276_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m276_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 276 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_register_rehire_276
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m276_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}

		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m276_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}

# #277 read-side projection; existence gates precede tuple reads.
zg361_we_m277_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m277_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m277_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m277_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 277 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_record_pip_exit_277
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_choice
				has_variable = zg361_we_m277_business_object_created
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ad_state
				}
			var:zg361_we_m277_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ad_owner
			var:zg361_we_m277_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ad_subject
			var:zg361_we_m277_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ad_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_we_m277_write_case = var:zg361_case_ad_case_serial
			var:zg361_we_m277_write_state = var:zg361_case_ad_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_we_m277_business_object_created = 1 }
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_pip_exit_vacancy
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_object_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_resource_formal_hc
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_resource_vacancy
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_resource_pip
						}
					var:zg361_we_m277_object_type_code = 277
					var:zg361_we_m277_consumer_contract = 277
					var:zg361_we_m277_object_owner = var:zg361_we_m277_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m277_object_subject = var:zg361_we_m277_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m277_object_cycle = var:zg361_we_m277_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m277_object_case = var:zg361_we_m277_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m277_object_state = var:zg361_we_m277_write_state
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_else = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_state
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_type_code
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_id
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_consumer_contract
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_due_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_open
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_consumed
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_debt_escalation_count
						}
					var:zg361_we_m277_choice = 3
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_open = 1
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_consumed = 0
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_type_code = 277
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_consumer_contract = 277
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_owner = var:zg361_we_m277_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_subject = var:zg361_we_m277_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_cycle = var:zg361_we_m277_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_case = var:zg361_we_m277_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_state = var:zg361_we_m277_write_state
					var:zg361_we_m277_debt_id = scope:zg361_we_m277_expected_debt_id
					}
					trigger_else = { always = no }
				}
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_we_m277_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_we_m277_consumed_owner = var:zg361_we_m277_write_owner
					var:zg361_we_m277_consumed_subject = var:zg361_we_m277_write_subject
					var:zg361_we_m277_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_we_m277_write_cycle
					var:zg361_we_m277_consumed_case = var:zg361_we_m277_write_case
					var:zg361_we_m277_consumed_state = var:zg361_we_m277_write_state
					}
				}

			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_we_m277_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_we_m277_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_we_m277_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_consumed_case value = var:zg361_we_m277_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_consumed_state value = var:zg361_we_m277_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_visible_value value = var:zg361_we_record_pip_exit_277 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_we_m277_write_case }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_we_m277_business_object_created = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_object_consumed value = 1 } set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_consumer_record_pip_exit_277 value = 1 } }
		else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m277_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_we_ad_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

				EXPECTED_STATE = 6
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_owner
				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_cycle
				RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_case

				EXPECTED_STATE = 6
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ad_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ad_subject

			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {

					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_case

					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m277_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2779 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
